name: PASSKISS
source: Princess Kikki is in love. However, she spends her days locked up in a castle because of a cruel king. Then one day, she meets the man of her dreams through a magic mirror. She has to escape the castle and go meet him!
translation: 琪琪公主恋爱了。然而，由于残酷的国王，她每天都被关在城堡里。有一天，她通过魔镜遇见了她的梦中情人。她必须逃离城堡，去见他！
